summary:
- Document title: TES main pumps hydraulic calculation report
- Client: Arizona Solar One, Project: HEX replacement TES Solana
- Document number: 4521-CAL-AEE-58-11-0002-GAR, Revision: 02
- Purpose: Evaluate implications of replacing existing TES System plate heat exchangers with new Lointek’s H&MB heat exchangers
- Simulation cases include various operating modes for Molten Salts and HTF circuits
- Assumptions based on plant geometry, equipment performance, and operational parameters
- HTF circuit is a closed loop with backpressure from an expansion tank.
- 10 main pumps (2 in standby) send HTF to solar field and heat exchangers.
- Simulation includes 10 far-field pumps, 6 heat exchangers, and 2 steam generators.
- Assumptions based on latest 3D models, pipe details, and operational data.
- Three scenarios for molten salts circuit: optimal speed, max speed, and full valve open.
- Case A shows pump performance at optimum speed with control valve fully open.
summary_points: Document title: TES main pumps hydraulic calculation report
Client: Arizona Solar One, Project: HEX replacement TES Solana
Purpose: Evaluate implications of replacing existing TES System plate heat exchangers with new Lointek’s H&MB heat exchangers
Simulation cases include various operating modes for Molten Salts and HTF circuits
Assumptions based on plant geometry, equipment performance, and operational parameters
HTF circuit is a closed loop with backpressure from an expansion tank.
10 main pumps (2 in standby) send HTF to solar field and heat exchangers.
Simulation includes 10 far-field pumps, 6 heat exchangers, and 2 steam generators.
Assumptions based on latest 3D models, pipe details, and operational data.
Three scenarios for molten salts circuit: optimal speed, max speed, and full valve open.
Case A shows pump performance at optimum speed with control valve fully open.
Case B demonstrates pump at maximum speed with control valve regulating flow.
Case C calculates the maximum allowed flow through the system.
The HTF circuit includes main pumps and heat exchangers with identical performances.
Pump data is provided for TES charging and discharging operations.
Max charging and steam generation requires a pump speed of 1712 rpm.
Nominal discharge operation has a pump speed of 1064 rpm.
